boundary: Reuse applies only within one invocation and exact pinned route identity. The owner-backed runtime is in the local ZIP; GitHub's standalone finite reference does not authenticate owners.
next: Test a separately specified cross-invocation certificate handoff that revalidates source identity and never inherits another task's obligations or stale status.
observation: Two distinct left-route tasks shared one two-pass owner-backed route audit, completed independently, and retained separate task fingerprints. A right-only edge remained unproved on the left route.
preserved: Exact owner/source pin audits, separate task obligations, no cross-route edge borrowing, cached tasks not fresh, and zero new source observations.
summary: One fresh route certificate can serve multiple independently declared tasks in a bounded on-demand owner-backed audit.
title: Shared fresh route certificate across tasks
